title: Mystic Sorceress with Staff
description: A female character with fiery orange hair stands dynamically in a ruined fantasy cityscape, holding a large ornate staff emitting swirling cyan magical energy while her other hand projects blue lightning. She wears a brown and grey corset-style outfit with glowing blue accents, thigh-high stockings, and flowing ribbons, set against a hazy, warm-toned background of crumbling gothic towers.
prompt: A beautiful young sorceress with voluminous fiery orange and yellow hair floating upwards stands in a dramatic pose in a ruined gothic fantasy city at dusk, holding a long ornate staff with a large intricate headpiece that swirls with bright cyan magical energy and sparks, her other hand extended casting blue lightning magic, wearing a detailed brown leather corset top with grey sleeves, short grey skirt with glowing blue circular accents, black thigh-high stockings with gold patterns, long flowing white and grey ribbons trailing from her waist, dramatic lighting with warm orange haze and cool blue magical glows, highly detailed digital fantasy art style
